notes.subject: סיר — pot
notes.rationale: Ol man bilong taun i tok: taun em i pot, yumi ol mit insait (11:3, 11:7); Yahwe i trautokim: pot i no ken holsterpela yu, bai yu go ausait na dai long laget.

notes.subject: pot na mit
notes.rationale: Liklik stori bilong taun (11:3) — Hebrew i yusim piksa bilong kukum; Tok Pisin i holim piksa stret.

notes.subject: i no ken stap / na yupela bai i save
notes.rationale: Ves 11 i no gat 'and you will know' long Hebrew — mi no tromoi putim; tasol negativ pasin i askim help bilong 'ken'.

translation: Em i no ken kamap bilong yupela long wanpela pot, na yupela i no ken stap insait long en long olsem mit; long laget bilong Yisrael bai mi skelim yupela ⟨את⟩, na yupela bai i save long mi.
